chunks: Whatever is in it from Jarrāḥ al-Madāʾinī, I have narrated it from my father, may Allah be pleased with him, from Saʿd ibn ʿAbdullah, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from al-Naḍr ibn Suwayd, from al-Qāsim ibn Sulaymān, from Jarrāḥ al-Madāʾinī.

key_terms.أَبِي: my father; the immediate source in the chain
key_terms.أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, a transmitter in the chain
key_terms.جَرَّاحِ الْمَدَائِنِيِّ: Jarrāḥ al-Madāʾinī, the final narrator named in this sanad/isnad
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates the author’s direct statement of transmission
key_terms.سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Saʿd ibn ʿAbdullah, a transmitter in the chain

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Jarrāḥ al-Madāʾinī in Man lā yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Jarrāḥ al-Madāʾinī in Man lā yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. Its significance lies in documenting the transmission route for hadith preservation and source verification.
